I don’t track that kind of thing—it’s not my job. The platform might have some numbers, but I’d have to ask the support team about that. I just deal with my own company’s drones and jobs.

For me, yesterday’s closure was a headache. We had three deliveries stuck because the closure blocked the usual routes, and one inspection had to be rerouted last minute. I had to call off one drone entirely because the battery was too low to find an alternative path. And then, when the closure got extended, I had to scramble to reassign the loads to other drones before they missed their deadlines.

But I don’t know how bad it was for the other companies. Maybe they were fine, maybe they had worse problems—I just focus on what’s in front of me.
